label: before-certified
protocol: Production world, actual engine/controller/38 production vehicles, seed982; fixed 30 ticks at 60Hz, then freeze simulation for pixel matching; normal chase camera on drive views. No traffic removed. Medium/DPR1. Static views use QA art camera only.

signDepth.method: Packed RGBA depth from actual production WebGL meshes, 45 lettering samples. Front-facing signs <=65m, >=8px tall and >=25 on-screen samples; 8cm depth tolerance. Poles, traffic and neighboring architecture remain present.
